power.jaymospowers.xenoform.desc: A band of alien metal from a fallen star. Turn its dial and slam it: you become one of the aliens it holds, for a while, with its body and its moves. Scan creatures to teach it new ones.
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.starter: The band: hold %5$s and scroll to turn the dial, let go of %5$s to slam it and become the dialled alien (as an alien, hold it to turn back). A form lasts 1-5 minutes (always 5 once mastered); when its health is gone you're knocked back into your own body. Fists only while changed. A corrupted band glitches: slams can give the wrong alien, and it may change you on its own
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: The dialled alien's first move (slam the band with %5$s to change first)
Fist Combo: three quick blows on whatever is in reach; the last sends it flying
Ground Clap: a shockwave through everything within 5 blocks
Grab: lift the creature you look at overhead; again to hurl it. Looking at the ground instead rips a chunk out and throws it
Leap Slam: a great leap; the landing hits everything within 4 blocks
Fire Bolt: a small fireball where you look
Flame Jet: G to take off and hover (WASD, Jump rises, Sneak sinks), Sprint to streak along your look as a comet of flame; G again, or Sneak on the ground, to come down. Free
Fire Nova: everything within 5 blocks is burnt and set alight
Magma Trail: for 6 seconds the ground burns where you step
Velocity (toggle): run far faster, up walls, over blocks and across water in a light blue streak; Shift walks, R again stops
Rapid Punches: six quick blows on the creature you aim at
Cyclone: sweeps everything within 6 blocks round you in a tight circle and lifts it
Chain Strike: flicker between up to 5 foes within 8 blocks, striking each
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode: Hold and scroll: turn the dial. Let go: slam the band and become the dialled alien. As an alien, hold to turn back
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.bul: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.pyr: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.blu: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.special: Scan (hold, as yourself): point at a creature for 3 seconds; if it carries an alien's DNA, the band learns that alien. Iron golem, blaze, horse, shulker, phantom, silverfish, the Warden and the Ender Dragon
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Ultimate (once the band is complete and the power mastered, the power ascends): as an alien, %6$s turns you into its Ultimate form, a bigger armoured body with spikes and glowing seams, half again the health on top, harder fists and every move back twice as fast, until the charge runs out. Its own move, where it has one, is on %4$s. %6$s again drops you back to the base alien. As yourself, nothing: slam first
Ultimate
item.jaymospowers.xeno_band.lore: A band of alien metal, warm to the touch. It wants a wrist.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.band_close: The band closes round your wrist. It won't come off.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.band_refus: The band won't close: something in you already answers to another power.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.only_one: The band only knows %s. Scan creatures to teach it more.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.hold_z: Hold the Power Mode key, scroll to pick an alien, and let go to slam the band.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.scan_human: The band can't scan while you're changed.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.unlocked: The band takes in new DNA: %s.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.star_band: Something glints in the broken star: a band of alien metal.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.star_symbi: Black goo oozes out of the broken star and gathers itself on the rock, watching you.
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Crystal Shards: three shards fan out where you look, each cutting the first thing in its way
Crystal Wall: a wall of amethyst rises 3 blocks ahead of you for 10 seconds
Reflect (hold): root yourself in crystal; arrows that hit you fly back at the shooter, other projectiles shatter
Spike Field: crystal bursts from the ground, cutting and slowing everything within 4 blocks
Phase: slip through a wall up to 2 blocks thick
Shroud: fade from sight until you strike something (again to show yourself)
Dread Wail: every creature within 10 blocks turns and flees; players are plunged into darkness
Glide (hold): fall slowly and drift forward. A ghost is never hurt by a fall
Spring: a huge jump, landing softly
Sabotage: from up to 16 blocks, flip a lever or button, throw a door, trapdoor or gate, or pop a piece of redstone off its block
Bite: a nip that steals hunger from the bitten and feeds you
Climb (hold): scuttle straight up any wall. You fit through one-block gaps
Sonic Boom: a ringing blast straight ahead that goes through walls
Tremor Sense (hold): everything that lives within 24 blocks glows for you
Shriek: everything within 12 blocks is hurt, plunged into darkness and slowed
Burrow: sink into the ground and come up where you look, up to 16 blocks away
Dragon's Breath: a cloud of purple fire ahead of you
Wings (hold): fly where you look, for free; let go and you drift down
Wing Gust: one great beat throws everything within 6 blocks away from you
Rift: step through the void to where you look, up to 12 blocks. Water and rain burn you
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.glitch_wro: The band glitches: that's not the alien you dialled.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.glitch_sel: The band glitches and changes you on its own!
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.pri: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.wis: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge

power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.wyr: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Titan: twice your size with a hide of stone (+12 armour, +20 health); the Ground Clap smashes walls up to 3 blocks thick ahead of you
Titan
Sunheart: the Flame Jet streaks faster with a longer comet, and R is a held beam of fire 12 blocks long
Sunheart
Standstill: for 6 s everything within 24 blocks crawls and every projectile hangs in the air, and you are fast; %4$s every 30 s
Standstill
Geode: everything within 6 blocks is cased in crystal for 4 s (held fast, no striking), projectiles shatter, and you're hard as the crystal; %4$s again every 20 s
Geode
Revenant: slip into the creature you look at (8 blocks) and wear it for 10 s: it goes where you look and nothing hunts you; %4$s lets go
Revenant
Swarm: you split into 4 glowing gremlins that bite what you bite; %4$s swaps you with the farthest one (nearest while sneaking)
Swarm
The Tolling: plant yourself and toll 5 times, every 2 s a ring of sonic force (6 damage, a shove, darkness) through everything within 8 blocks; %4$s again after 30 s
The Tolling
Elder Wyrm: twice your size with +8 armour, a breath every 2 s and a gust that reaches 50% farther
Elder Wyrm
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.ultimate_h: Slam the band first: the Ultimate is the alien's.
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Split: a double of you steps out (up to 3), and your name grows: Triplex, Quadruplex... Each has 6 health; together they surround what you fight and strike in turn, harder the more of them there are; if one dies, you take 2

Rally: your doubles swarm the creature you aim at (16 blocks); aimed at nothing, they come back. Sneak: Fetch, a double picks up the solid block you aim at and carries it; sneak again to have it set it down where you aim
Switch: trade places with the double you aim at, or the farthest one. Sneak: look out through the aimed double's eyes (or the farthest, 48 blocks) while you stand still; V again comes back
Merge: every double within 24 blocks runs back into you, each healing you 3
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.dup: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Copper Storm: a full set of doubles, then lightning on each: 6 damage to everything within 3 of them, and they're charged (fast, strong, glowing) for 20 s; up to 6 doubles meanwhile. %4$s strikes again, every 20 s
Copper Storm
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Beacon: tap to pick a player anywhere in the world (tap again for the next; they show through everything for a moment); hold to phase to them, whatever world they're in

Rift: tap at a creature for Recursive Drop (a maw under it and one in the sky: it falls through, over and over, 7 times); tap at nothing to blink where you look (16 blocks); hold to Surface, straight up to the highest safe ground; sneak + G opens the Void Pocket (27 slots, kept for the next Nadir)

Graviton: at a creature, Heavy Hand (tap: yank it to you; hold: slam and pin it; sneak + tap: shove it away; sneak + hold: throw it high). At nothing, tap: a Weightless zone where you look (what enters floats up helpless, then drops hard). At nothing, hold: an Event Horizon, a black hole that drags everything in, erases small things at its core, then collapses (once every 45 s)
Command: open the Rules screen and write up to three rules (WHO + WHAT + WHEN, such as "what I hit / burns / while sprinting"); two can hold at once, while Nadir is out
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Three Worlds Film: a short film (any key skips your camera) of the Overworld, the Nether and the Aether flashing up behind what you look at, then a heavy blow that hurts what stands close too (once every 75 s). Only a picture: no portal, no new world
Three Worlds Film
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.beacon_alo: There is no one else to go to.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.beacon_arr: %s steps out of the void behind you.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir.rift: No room between ground and sky for the maws.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir.surf: There is no safe ground above.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir.hori: A black hole is already open.
The void is still gathering: %s s.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.sub: Write what the world must do. %s rules hold at once.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.help: Click a word to change it (sneak-click goes back), and the switch to make a rule hold. Rules hold only while Nadir is out, and wait here for the next time.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.dar: Night vision, for as long as the rule holds.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.bur: Set alight for 4 s (no more than every 2 s, or once a second for each creature struck).
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.wea: Weakness II and Mining Fatigue: it hits softly and works slowly.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.pus: Thrown away from you. Does nothing to you.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.pul: Dragged toward you. Does nothing to you.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.bur: A burst of the void round it: 2.5 hearts and a throw to everything within 3 blocks but you and yours.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.pai: Takes 2 hearts. Does nothing to you.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.name: Hush
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.name: Clamour
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.wake: ...you've gone far enough into the band to hear us. I am the still one. We will ask, and ask again, for as long as you wear it.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.wake: AND I AM THE LOUD ONE. You've broken the band and climbed it both. Good. Now ANSWER, and keep answering.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.given: Then we agree, for once. Take what we keep: the void given shape. Once. Then you will answer us again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.give: NADIR IS YOURS. ONCE. Don't make us sorry.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.already: You have answered me. I am still thinking on it.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.alre: YOU SAID YOUR PIECE. Now DO something.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir_refu: The band will not turn: the voices are not content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q0: When you could strike, will you stay your hand?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q0: When you could stay your hand, WILL YOU STRIKE?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.yes0: Then there is hope for you yet.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no0: No. That is not what you are. I will ask again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no0: LIAR. Nobody holds back who's held THIS. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q1: Is the band a gift, to be kept whole?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q1: Is the band a WEAPON, to be spent?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.yes1: SPEND IT, THEN. Spend it all.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no1: A thing this old is not spent. I will ask again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no1: A GIFT? It eats you alive and you call it a GIFT? Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q2: Would you give the band up, if the world asked it?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q2: Would you BURN the world before you gave it up?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.yes2: Then you may be trusted with it.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.yes2: GOOD. Mine, and yours. Nobody else's.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no2: You would not. I heard it in you. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no2: COWARD. You'd hand us over? Think again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q3: Are the creatures you wear still themselves, somewhere in you?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q3: Are they only SHAPES, worn and thrown away?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no3: They are. You've only not listened. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no3: SENTIMENT. They're meat you learned. Again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q4: Would you walk away from a fight you could win?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q4: Would you finish a fight you could WALK FROM?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no4: You would not walk. Not yet. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no4: WALK? From a WIN? Again, and mean it.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q5: If I asked you to put the band down for a day, would you?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q5: If I asked you to wear it a DAY WITHOUT TURNING BACK, would you?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.yes5: Then it does not own you.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.yes5: THAT'S the spirit. Never come down.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no5: It owns you more than you know. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no5: You'd take it OFF? Again, later, when you've thought.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.contrad: (...you told the other what it wished to hear as well. So be it. Both of us are listening now.)
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.cont: (YOU TOLD THE OTHER THE OPPOSITE. Hah. Fine. We'll BOTH see what you do.)
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.deed.pe: Change, and let the change run its whole course without a blow struck. %s times. Then I am content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.deed.re: Change, and turn back by your own hand before the band makes you. %s times. Then I am content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.deed: CHANGE, AND END %s LIVES AS ONE OF US. Then I'm content. Not before.
CHANGE, AND BE BEATEN OUT OF THE SHAPE %s TIMES. Bleed for it. Then I'm content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.count.p: %s of %s changes have passed in peace.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.count.r: %s of %s changes ended by your own hand.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.done.re: %s times you let go. I am content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.done: %s BEATINGS TAKEN. I'M CONTENT. For now.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.lent: We are content. Once more, the void is yours to wear.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.spent: And it is gone from you again. We have new questions.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.spen: THAT'S YOUR TURN SPENT. Earn the next one.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir.film: The film needs someone to show.
The reel is still rewinding: %s s.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.band_won: You tear the band off %s's wrist. It's yours now.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.band_lost: %s tore the band from your wrist.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.saved: The band slammed itself: %s took the blow.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.wild_stuck: The wild dial won't let you go.

power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Nightfall: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast
Nightfall
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.gorger.emp: Nothing in the gut to bring up.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.slipfin.dr: Your skin is drying out. Find water.

Gust: a cone of wind 8 blocks ahead that shoves everything, puts out burning creatures and the fires in its way
Whirlwind: a small whirlwind where you look (16 blocks) drags creatures round and up for 2 seconds, 3 damage a second
Shell: hold: pull into your shell. Arrows and other shots glance off, but you crawl
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.gyr: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Tempest Shell: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast
Tempest Shell

Bubble: a mind-bubble round you for 6 seconds that stops every shot
Mind Lift: lift the creature you look at (16 blocks) into the air with your mind, and let it drop
Claw Snap: the big claw, 7 damage within 3.5, and it holds the target slow
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.cor: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Overmind: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast
Overmind

Hops: three quick short hops where you look
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.loc: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Swarmking: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast
Swarmking

Croak: a booming croak; everything within 6 takes 2 and is stunned slow, players sick, monsters forget you
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.cro: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Bog King: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast
Bog King

Play Dead: flop over; monsters lose interest for 3 seconds
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.dud: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Dud has no Ultimate: nothing happens
Nothing

Ice Shards: a spray of ice shards, as Cryokinesis's
Flash Freeze: freeze the creature you look at solid, as Cryokinesis's
Ice Wall: raise a wall of ice ahead, as Cryokinesis's
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.rim: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge

Hoarfrost

Bone Shield: bone plates for 5 s; shots glance off and blows land softer

power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.mar: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Ossuary: half again as much health and hitting power, and the rise grows back: once each change, a killing blow drops Marrow in a heap and it stands up at half health
Ossuary

Lash Pull: a lash round the creature you look at (12 blocks) drags it to you
Sandstorm: 6 s of scouring sand round you that blinds and stings; wider and harder in deserts and badlands
Wrap: bind your wounds: bleeding stops and you heal for 5 s
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.swa: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Unbound: half again as much health and hitting power, and every move back twice as fast. Swathe never drowns or starves
Unbound
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Skull: a wither skull from the middle head
Volley: a skull from each head, fanned; the middle one is the blue kind that breaks blocks
Rot Touch: the creature in reach takes 6 and withers, and the grass, leaves and crops round it rot
Dark Pulse: a ring of decay 6 blocks round you throws back and withers everything
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.bli: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Withering: half again as much health and hitting power. At half health or less the dark shield rises and shots can't touch Blight; the Wither effect never can
Withering
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.marrow.hea: The bones fall in a heap... and start to pull back together.
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Pounce: leap where you look; the first creature you land on takes 6 and is knocked down for 2 s
Howl: the wild wolves within 32 blocks answer and hunt beside you for a minute
Scent: for 10 s the blood stains near you show (only to you), and every bleeder within 48 glows
Lockjaw: bite the creature in reach for 4 and hold on for 4 s, dragging and gnawing it; again to let go
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.how: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Alpha: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast. Howl is stronger at night
Alpha
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Long Pounce: a long, low leap; the first creature you land on takes 6 and is pinned for 3 s
Rake: claws across the creature in reach, 5 and a dirty, bleeding cut
Stalk: mark the creature you look at (32 blocks) for 20 s; it glows, and near it you hit harder
Roar: every mob within 12 blocks breaks off and runs
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.pro: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Apex: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast. Prowl moves without a sound, is hard to see while sneaking, and falls under 12 blocks never hurt it
Apex

Gore: the tusks into the creature in reach, 6, a bleeding cut and a shove
Root Out: dig the ground at your feet (or where you look) for roots and truffles: food, and sometimes seeds or bone meal
Thick Hide: for 10 s nothing knocks you back, and blows land softer
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.tus: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Warhog: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast
Warhog

Drop: let go of what you carry; with nothing held, a talon strike of 5
Far Sight: for 10 s every monster within 96 blocks shows through fog and walls, and you see in the dark
Feather Darts: a fan of five hard quills
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.tal: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Sky Tyrant: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast. Talon flies: hold jump in the air to beat your wings, let go to glide, sneak to drop. Falls never hurt it
Sky Tyrant
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.tusk.no_gr: No soft ground here to root in.

Tentacles: up to four creatures within 6 are seized and held to you for 4 s, slowed and squeezed; again to let go
Jet: a dash where you look, far in water, short on land
Lure: a glow for 10 s that draws fish and mobs in the water within 24 to you

Frenzy: for 10 s, faster and stronger for each bleeder within 16 (up to three)
Death Roll: what you hold in your jaws is rolled and torn for 2 s, then thrown down

power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Megalodon: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast. Gnasher swims fast, and bleeders in water within 48 glow for it
Megalodon
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Mend: you, the players and your pets within 8 heal 2 hearts
Flare: a flash that blinds every creature within 8 for 4 s
Light: a light hangs where you look for 30 s (six at most)

power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.lum: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge

Radiance

Screech: whatever flies within 16 takes 3 and is knocked out of the air
Drain: a bite of 4 that heals you 1.5 hearts
Echo: a dash where you look; in the dark you vanish for a moment as you go
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.kee: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge

Nightwing
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.gnasher.no: Nothing in your jaws to roll.

power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.sha: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge

Endshade

power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.mir: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge

Hall of Mirrors
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.shade.no_b: Nothing there you can pull loose.

Squeeze: thin right down, small enough for a one-block gap; again (with room) to fill out

power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.ooz: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge

Chain Reaction

Thorn Volley: a fan of five thorns
Hedge: a wall of leaves grows in front of you; it withers after 30 s
Bloom: for 10 s crops and saplings round your feet grow
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.tho: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge

Elder Grove

Thunderhead: a bolt of 8 on the creature you aim at (no fires)
Gust: everything in front of you is blown back
Fog: for 10 s creatures round you are blinded and lose you
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.bil: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Stormfront: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast. Billow floats (jump to rise, sneak to sink), and up to three friends can ride on its back: right-click it, sneak to get off
Stormfront
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.ooze.no_ro: No room here to fill back out.
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Grab: rear back, snatch the creature you aim at, squeeze it and slam it into the ground. Get out of reach while you rear back and it's missed
Stomp: a shockwave twice as far as a step's runs along the ground and throws everything up
Swat: tap, and you draw your arm back across your chest, slow and heavy, then a backhand flings everything in front of you aside
Roar: monsters round you are weakened, slowed and lose you
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.tow: Tap: rise to monolith-giant size (open sky only), or come back down. Hold and let go: turn back into yourself. Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Colossus: half again as much health and hitting power, a little bigger, and every move back twice as fast. Every step Towerback takes stomps; jump the shockwave to dodge it
Colossus
Not under open sky: no room to rise.
item.jaymospowers.star_tablet.tooltip: Green marks no one here can read. A band might.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.tablet_not: The band reads the tablet, and finds nothing it doesn't already hold.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.craft_grem: Gremlin needs %s probe circuits and an amethyst shard for a tablet.
jei.jaymospowers.xeno_gremlin.how: As Gremlin, sneak and use a crafting table.
jei.jaymospowers.xeno_tablet.read: Hold a tablet as you slam the band to learn an alien.
jei.jaymospowers.xeno_bulwark.how: As Bulwark, sneak and use a grindstone, ore in hand.
jei.jaymospowers.xeno_bulwark.smelt: Each dust smelts into an ingot.
jei.jaymospowers.xeno_pyre.how: As Pyre, sneak and use with it in hand (8 at a time).
jei.jaymospowers.found.star_tablet: Found in fallen stars, fishing treasure and the remnants' chests, dropped by the mechs that hunt band wearers at night, and put together by Gremlin from probe circuits. Hold one as you slam the band and it learns an alien it didn't hold.
jei.jaymospowers.found.probe_circuit: Dropped by the probes a star wreck sends out while a band wearer is near, and found in the wreck itself.
jei.jaymospowers.found.wreck_core: The heart of a star wreck: mine the wreck with an iron pickaxe or better. About one fallen star in ten comes down a wreck.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.greet.1: Mind the edge. The ground is still warm, if you put your hand to it.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.greet.2: I saw it come down. Most don't look up in time.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.greet.3: You walked a long way to look at a hole. So did I.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.greet.4: Every star that falls was going somewhere. I read where.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.again.2: The sky's in no hurry. Ask.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.opt.tablet: Trade %s star metal for a tablet
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.opt.band: Ask them to read your band
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.short: Star metal, and enough of it. I can't eat promises.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.sold.1: There. It's been talking to itself all week. Perhaps it will talk to you.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.sold.2: Carry it near your heart and hold it up when your wrist wakes.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.sold.3: A fair trade. The metal goes back to the sky one way or another.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.band.some: It dreams of %s shapes it has never worn. The sky still owes it.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.band.one: One shape left that it has never worn. It aches for it, I think.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.band.all: Every shape it knows of, it has worn. Almost every one.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.band.only_: Every shape, even the broken one. I've never seen a band so full.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.hint.1: The ones who made those bands never meant them to be found. They fall anyway. Everything up there falls in the end.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.hint.2: When the little lights come after you, follow them home. Things that are sent come from somewhere.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.hint.3: Iron walkers come at night for the ones with a light on the wrist. Whatever they carry, they took from someone.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.hint.4: Somebody beats metal on one of the moons. I hear the hammer on clear nights. Don't ask me how.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.hint.5: A hurt band dreams wrongly. Now and then the wrong dream is one it never had before, and it keeps it.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.hint.6: Nets bring up more than fish. The deep keeps what falls into it, and gives a little back.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.hint.7: The great stones in the hills keep old things in their hollows. Older than this crater. Not older than the sky.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.hint.8: A tablet is only a voice. Hold it up when the band is waking and the band listens.
band.jaymospowers.module.cell.desc: Doubles the band's charge, and it refills in the same time, so twice as fast.
band.jaymospowers.module.breather.desc: Breathe under water, and in the thin air of the Pale Moon and the Maw, as yourself or as an alien.
band.jaymospowers.module.plating.desc: 8 armour, 10% more speed and no freezing, but only while you wear no armour at all.
band.jaymospowers.module.steady.desc: Holds a corrupted band still: no wrong aliens and no changes on its own. Can't be fitted with Wild.
band.jaymospowers.module.wild.desc: Makes the band glitch as if fully corrupted, even when it isn't: wrong aliens, changes on its own, and now and then an alien it never held. Can't be fitted with Steady.
band.jaymospowers.skill.quick.desc: Hold Z and scroll as an alien, then let go, to change straight into another alien for a quarter of the charge.
band.jaymospowers.skill.save.desc: A killing blow as yourself makes the band slam itself into an alien that fits the death. Once every 10 minutes.
band.jaymospowers.skill.reach.desc: Scan from 8 blocks further away for each rank (12, 20, 28).
band.jaymospowers.skill.charge.desc: A quarter more charge for each rank.
band.jaymospowers.skill.recharge.desc: An empty band refills a quarter faster for each rank.
item.jaymospowers.band_plan.tooltip: Use it while wearing a band and the band learns the module.
screen.jaymospowers.band.sub.unforged: Not reforged: no module slots yet
screen.jaymospowers.band.unknown.desc: The band hasn't learned this module. Module plans come from star-readers and star wrecks.
screen.jaymospowers.band.forget.desc: Take this alien off the dial. Scan it again, or read a tablet, to get it back.
screen.jaymospowers.band.help.modules: A reforged band has 3 module slots. Reforge it at the Star Forge, which stands on one of the far worlds; there the band hums toward it.
screen.jaymospowers.band.help.skills: Band points come from mastery: one for every 30 mastery points (8 at most), and one more once you've ascended. Points can't be taken back.
screen.jaymospowers.band.help.aliens: Click Forget or Wipe twice. Modules and skills stay; only the aliens go.
message.jaymospowers.band.plan_no_band: Only a band can read this.
message.jaymospowers.band.plan_learned: The band learned %s. Fit it from the band screen (B).
message.jaymospowers.band.plan_learned_u: The band learned %s, but it has no module slots until it is reforged.
message.jaymospowers.band.need_skill: Your band can't do that yet: buy %s on the band screen (B).
message.jaymospowers.band.hum.near: Your band hums: the forge is close, to the %s.
message.jaymospowers.band.hum.far: Your band hums faintly, far off to the %s.
message.jaymospowers.band.forge_no_band: The forge is cold to you. It works only on a band.
message.jaymospowers.band.forge_transfor: Turn back first. The band can't be reforged while it's in use.
message.jaymospowers.band.reforged: Your band is reforged. It has %s module slots now (B for the band screen).
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.greet.1: Another band. Let me see it. Hm. Soft metal, for what it's asked to do.
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.greet.2: I make bands harder than they were made. Bring me what I need.
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.greet.3: Don't touch the forge. Unless you're paying.
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.reforged: That band's mine now, as much as yours. It'll hold. What else?
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.lacking: Not with what you're carrying. Four star metal, a wreck's core, and four measures of ground ore. Then we talk.
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.made: There. Three slots where there were none. Plans tell a band what to do with them.
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.not_now: Not now. Come back with it empty, and with the makings.
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.modules: Plans. The star-readers trade them, and the wrecks keep a few. Read one and the band remembers it. Then fit what you like, three at a time.
talk.jaymospowers.star_smith.points: A band learns its wearer. The more you've mastered it, the more it will let you ask of it. Look at it closely: it knows what you've earned.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.opt.plan: Trade %2$s star metal for a plan: %1$s
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.plan_sold: Old marks on thin metal. Hold it to your wrist and see if it listens.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.forge.moon: On the pale one, where the ground is light underfoot, someone keeps a fire. Your band would hear it there.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.forge.rust: On the red world, where every step is heavy, a hammer answers the wind. Your band would hear it there.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.forge.glac: Out on the frozen sea, someone keeps a forge burning against the cold. Your band would hear it there.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.forge.cind: On the burning world a forge burns hotter than the rest. Your band would hear it there.
talk.jaymospowers.star_reader.forge.verd: Among the green world's roots someone beats star metal. Your band would hear it there.
jei.jaymospowers.found.band_plan: Traded by star-readers (4 star metal) and found in a quarter of mined star wrecks. Use it while wearing a band and the band learns the module; a reforged band fits up to 3 from the band screen (B as yourself).
jei.jaymospowers.found.star_forge: Stands in a smithy on one far world of each save, raised the first time a band wearer walks that world; the band hums toward it there. It reforges a band for 4 star metal, a wreck core and 4 metal dust. It can't be mined.
item.jaymospowers.rival_band.lore: Dark red and cold. It wants a wrist, and it isn't fussy whose.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.rival_clos: The red band bites shut on your wrist. Something in it is glad.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.rival_near: Your band goes cold. Somewhere out in the dark, another one answers it.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.rival_chan: He slaps the red band, and %s steps out of the light. Dark. Wrong.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.rival_beat: The hunter is down and dazed. Tap him to tear the band off.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.rival_take: You tear the red band off his wrist. He doesn't stay to argue.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.hunting.0: You don't deserve it. I can hear it on you from here.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.hunting.1: There are only two. Did nobody tell you? Soon there'll be one.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.hunting.2: Take it off and give it to me. You won't be asked twice.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.beaten.0: Not... yet. It's not done with me.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.beaten.1: It was mine first. Before yours fell. Before any of it.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.beaten.2: Go on, then. See if it likes you better.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.fled.0: Keep it. It'll eat you the way it ate me.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.fled.1: Don't follow me. I've nothing left for you.
talk.jaymospowers.band_hunter.fled.2: It's quiet. My wrist is so quiet.
jei.jaymospowers.found.rival_band: Never falls from the stars. The band hunter wears it: an outcast who comes some night for a Xeno-Band wearer while the rival band is out of the world. Beat his darkened alien, then tap him while he's dazed to tear it off (or kill him and it drops). Its dial starts with Gyre, Cortex, Locust and Croaker, darkened. Realms that have seen the alien call wearing it a crime.
screen.jaymospowers.band.sub.looks: How your band and its aliens look
screen.jaymospowers.band.help.looks: Dress the band: its glow (also the aliens' lines, the flash and the hologram), its face plate and spikes, and how each alien looks. All for show. The preview turns you about; an alien's look shows when you change.
screen.jaymospowers.band.glow.desc: The colour the band glows. Every alien's lines and insignia, the slam's flash and the dial's hologram take it too.
screen.jaymospowers.band.plate.desc: The shape of the band's face plate.
screen.jaymospowers.band.spikes.desc: Little spikes standing out of the band's sides.
screen.jaymospowers.band.look.desc: How this alien looks: plain, armoured (worked into plates, riveted) or weathered (faded, scratched, grimy).
